attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster player reaction source for HARVEST THE NIGHT.
Primary request: ONE south-facing farmer in a neutral planted idle pose, with ONE small exclamation mark (!) floating above and to the RIGHT of the hat. The mark is a compact warm cream/gold vertical stroke and separate dot, edged in dark violet/brown to remain readable on grass and at night. No words, surrounding speech balloon or glow. This is react_bang, a single held reaction frame, not an animation strip.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved farmer identity master; Image 2 is the approved idle_south strip, a body scale, clothing, face and planted-foot reference. They are references, not edit targets. Match the FIRST open-eyed pose of Image 2.
Style/medium: crisp coherent pixel art, deliberate clusters and colored outlines. Preserve straw hat with dark brown band, dark hair, cream rolled sleeves, blue bib overalls, brown boots and warm skin. Orthographic three-quarter top-down camera, SOUTH/front facing. Same calm proportions as the accepted farmer; no new costume, tool or prop.
Composition/framing: exactly ONE complete standing character, with generous genuine transparent margins. Body and boots match the neutral idle silhouette. The symbol floats in the upper-right headroom, separate from the hat, never covering face, brim or hands. Body about 20x30 native pixels; symbol about 5x10 native pixels, its center about 13 native pixels RIGHT of the body center and 3 pixels ABOVE the hat crown. Fit the combined art in a downstream 48x48 canvas with feet at (24,44), without shrinking the farmer to make room. No extra figure, row or label.
Lighting/mood: neutral warm daytime, upper-left highlights and darker underside. Runtime supplies night lighting. No painted glow, ground, contact shadow, particles or backdrop.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent alpha everywhere outside the farmer and exclamation mark, including the gap between them. No checkerboard drawing, vignette or matte.
Avoid: blur, gradients, smooth painting, random speckle, thick black boxes, duplicate hands, extra limbs, clipped boots/hat/symbol, frame borders, typography other than the requested symbol, watermark or UI.
attempts.decision: Rejected: native exclamation too thin and the dark edge joined the dot to the stem; preserve for targeted symbol revision.

attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production raster player reaction source for HARVEST THE NIGHT.
Primary request: Edit Image 1. Change ONLY the floating exclamation mark. Keep every farmer pixel, body height, face, hat, clothes, planted boots and source composition unchanged. The native preview reduced the old mark to a very thin stroke with its dark edge connecting the dot; it must read unmistakably as an exclamation, distinct from a question mark.
Input images: Image 1 is the current react_bang candidate and edit target. Image 2 is the approved farmer identity master, a reference only. Image 3 is the approved idle_south strip, a body/feet reference only.
Correction: replace the existing mark with a clean STRAIGHT vertical warm-cream/gold rectangular stem and a SEPARATE square dot below. Slightly widen the mark and increase its height; the downstream symbol should be about 5x10 native pixels when the farmer remains 30 pixels tall. The stem is vertical with a flat lower end, not curved, zigzagged or a hook. Leave a REAL transparent gap at least two downstream native pixels high between stem and dot, including their dark outlines; no dark bridge or decorative connector. Keep a simple thin dark violet/brown outline so the bright interior remains at least two native pixels wide. Place it above/right of the crown, centered about 13 native pixels right of the farmer's boot center. Keep it wholly within the same downstream 48x48 canvas with feet (24,44), never overlapping hat/face or shrinking the farmer.
Scene/backdrop: preserve genuine alpha outside farmer and symbol. No speech balloon, glow, shadow, ground, checkerboard, text, extra figure, prop or other change.
attempts.decision: Accepted: stable 30px farmer, planted feet (24,44), clean source/native alpha, distinct floating symbol at native and nearest 3x, existing reaction selection/lifetime and idle-only suppression, day/dusk/night review and complete viewport-edge glyphs passed. Renderer split equals the committed combined PNG pixel-for-pixel.

attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated production raster ground-shadow source for HARVEST THE NIGHT.
Primary request: ONE compact horizontal oval contact shadow, a flat stepped pixel silhouette in a single uniform very dark violet/brown color. It grounds the approved straw-hat farmer's planted boots. The farmer reference is for scale and perspective ONLY: do not draw the farmer or boots. This is the separate shadow asset, not a scene or character edit.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved farmer identity master, showing the body and boots whose contact this shadow supports. Image 2 is the approved idle_south strip, showing the planted stance. Both are scale/style references only.
Style/medium: crisp restrained pixel art, hard binary silhouette with simple stepped edges. Flat orthographic ground-plane oval about four times as wide as high, symmetric left/right and front/back. The downstream native canvas is 20x8; the visible shadow should be about 18x4, centered at (10,4). This is a downstream import target, so keep the source simple enough to reduce cleanly.
Composition: exactly one complete detached oval silhouette centered with generous true transparent outer margins. No interior holes, duplicate shadow, border, extra part or colored highlight.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent alpha outside the oval. Single uniform solid dark interior, no softer fringe, gradient, feathering, glow, painted halo, checkerboard, vignette, ground texture or background. Runtime modulate supplies partial transparency; do not paint a second shadow into any character.
Avoid: character, boots, object, cast-light direction, long diagonal shape, perspective volume, smooth painting, blurry edges, text, labels, watermark or UI.
attempts.decision: Accepted: source-proportional uniform reduction gives an 18x3 visible one-color contact ellipse in the existing 20x8 canvas; stable feet, clean alpha, one shared shadow, and actual renderer contrast (23 exposed pixels changed) passed native/nearest-3x review.
